ar.title: سوتيه البطاطس

steps.n1: يسلق البطاطس بقشره في ماء مغلي مع الملح والخل.
steps.n2: بعد النضج يقشر ويهرس بالشوكة جيدا وهو ساخن.
steps.n3: نحضر إناء به قليل من الزبد وتسخن فقط ثم نضع البطاطس ونقلبه قليلا حتى يتماسك مع الزبد ثم نرفعه من الحرارة.

en.title: Sautéed Potatoes

steps.n1: Boil the potatoes in their skins in boiling water with salt and vinegar.
steps.n2: Once cooked, peel them and mash thoroughly with a fork while still hot.
steps.n3: Prepare a pan with a little butter and heat it slightly, then add the potatoes and toss briefly until they are well combined with the butter, then remove from heat.
steps.n4: Season with salt, pepper, and chopped parsley.

legacySteps: Boil the potatoes in their skins in boiling water with salt and vinegar.
Once cooked, peel them and mash thoroughly with a fork while still hot.
Prepare a pan with a little butter and heat it slightly, then add the potatoes and toss briefly until they are well combined with the butter, then remove from heat.
Season with salt, pepper, and chopped parsley.
